headline.title: Zero-day exploit completely defeats default Windows 11 BitLocker protections
headline.summary: A newly discovered zero-day exploit has successfully bypassed the default protections of BitLocker in Windows 11. Microsoft is currently investigating the issue to determine the specifics of the exploit.

articles.title: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2: Open Apache 2.0 Multilingual Embeddings with 32K Context — Best Sub-100M Retrieval Quality
articles.summary: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2 has been released under the Apache 2.0 license, offering open-source multilingual embeddings with a context size of 32,000 tokens. This model aims to achieve high retrieval quality while maintaining a parameter count under 100 million.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Codex is now in the ChatGPT mobile app
articles.summary: OpenAI has integrated its Codex tool into the ChatGPT mobile app, allowing users to write code and interact with applications directly from their phones. This move comes as OpenAI aims to enhance its offerings in response to the growing popularity of competing AI tools like Anthropic's Claude Code.

articles.title: Cisco announces record revenue and 4,000 layoffs in the same day
articles.summary: Cisco reported record revenue while simultaneously announcing 4,000 layoffs, clarifying that the job cuts are not part of a savings-driven restructuring. The company's CFO emphasized that the layoffs are intended to streamline operations rather than reduce costs.

articles.title: What happens when AI starts building itself?
articles.summary: Richard Socher's new startup has secured $650 million in funding to develop an AI capable of self-research and continuous improvement. The company aims to create practical applications for this self-evolving technology.

articles.title: Cerebras raises $5.5B, then stock pops $108%, in the first huge tech IPO of 2026
articles.summary: Cerebras has successfully raised $5.5 billion in its initial public offering (IPO), marking a significant milestone as the first major tech IPO of 2026. Following the IPO, the company's stock surged by 108%.

articles.title: OpenAI is reportedly preparing legal action against Apple; it wouldn’t be the first partner to feel burned
articles.summary: OpenAI is reportedly preparing to take legal action against Apple, having engaged an outside law firm to explore its options. This development follows a trend of strained relationships between OpenAI and its partners.

articles.title: Khosla Ventures is betting $10M on Ian Crosby, whose first startup, Bench, imploded
articles.summary: Khosla Ventures has invested $10 million in Ian Crosby's new venture, Synthetic, which aims to create a fully autonomous AI bookkeeping service for startups. This investment follows the failure of Crosby's previous startup, Bench.

articles.title: Trump’s Tech Posse in China, Who’s Winning in Musk v. Altman, and Hantavirus Conspiracy Theories
articles.summary: The latest episode of Uncanny Valley explores the potential impact of Donald Trump's visit to China on global economic and foreign policy discussions. Additionally, the episode examines the rivalry between Elon Musk and Sam Altman, as well as the emergence of conspiracy theories surrounding Hantavirus.

articles.title: Cisco cuts nearly 4,000 jobs to spend more on AI, reports ‘record quarterly revenue’
articles.summary: Cisco has announced the layoff of nearly 4,000 employees as part of a strategy to allocate more resources towards artificial intelligence initiatives. Despite the job cuts, the company reported record quarterly revenue, highlighting its ongoing growth.

articles.title: Two weeks left: Startup Battlefield 200 applications close May 27
articles.summary: Applications for the Startup Battlefield 200 are closing on May 27, offering startups the chance to gain access to venture capital, global visibility, and TechCrunch coverage, along with the opportunity to win $100,000 in equity-free funding. Interested startups are encouraged to apply before the deadline.

articles.title: Wirestock raises $23M to supply creative multimodal data to AI labs
articles.summary: Wirestock has raised $23 million to enhance its role as a data provider, supplying multimodal datasets including images, videos, design assets, and 3D content to AI laboratories. The company's pivot to this model occurred in 2023, aiming to meet the growing demand for diverse data in AI development.
